"8WUSN27..0A1G" is silkscreened on the board, indicating this device is an '''Alpha Networks''' device (w/ an internal model of WUS-N27). :This is the same text found on the [[D-Link DWA-123 rev B1]]'s board. There is no FCC ID on the label, but the FCC ID of the DWA-123 B1 has been assigned to this entry.
[http://ftp.dlink.ru/pub/Wireless/DWA-125/Drivers/rev.B/2.00/DWA-125_B1_relese%20note_for%20Utitly_V2.00s0002.pdf It is estimated to have been released April 2012.]
